name: phantom-plugins
description: Plugins for Phantom IDEA, installed on demand instead of bundled

plugins.name: Phantom Database Console
plugins.description: Connect to MySQL, PostgreSQL or H2 over JDBC and run SQL from the editor: highlighting, Ctrl+Enter to run the statement at the caret, a sortable result grid and a lazily loaded schema tree. Drivers come from the project's dependencies or the local Gradle/Maven cache.

plugins.name: Phantom Spring
plugins.description: Spring support for Java and Kotlin: bean injection navigation in both directions, an autowiring inspection, correct unused analysis for Spring-managed code, and the Endpoints tool window for Spring MVC handlers.

plugins.name: Phantom Spring Boot
plugins.description: Spring Boot support: File → New → Project → Spring Boot generates projects with Spring Initializr, and application*.yml / application*.properties get completion and quick documentation for keys and values, from library metadata and the project's own @ConfigurationProperties, in Java and Kotlin.
